ranked_facts.concept_key: symptoms of occasional slight pain
ranked_facts.why: The symptom of occasional slight pain is more aligned with the clinical presentation of vascular tumors in branch B1, which can cause discomfort due to their growth, rather than vascular malformations in branch B3, which may not typically cause pain unless they are complicated by other factors.
